text:
maya: Heads up — Rowan Health (midmarket) just told renewal rep they're likely to downgrade to Starter. Main issues: onboarding delays, missing webhook support, and usage not matching expectations. Need a quick save plan. cc @arun @jenna

arun: Ugh. Renewal date?

maya: ~21 days out. They said the lack of webhooks blocks our ingestion flow. Also onboarding stalled after first week.

jenna: I can run an accelerated onboarding session. I have a 1.5hr template for midmarket accounts. Friday 10am PT free?

leo: I can scope a temporary webhook proxy so they get events in the short term. 48–72h lift, then we ship proper webhooks in next sprint.

arun: OK — proposed stopgap (quick):
- Dedicated 90-min onboarding + gap checklist (jenna)
- 48h webhook proxy (leo)
- 30% credit for next billing period if they commit to 6mo renew (commercial)
- Weekly 30m check-ins for 6 weeks, success metrics defined

maya: Love it. I'll lead comms and offer the credit. Draft outreach below — please tweak.

maya: ```
Hi Sam,
Thanks for the honest feedback — we want to make this right.
Proposed immediate plan: 1) Dedicated onboarding session (Fri 10am PT) 2) Temporary webhook proxy to mirror events into your system (48–72h) 3) 30% credit on next invoice if you confirm a 6-month renewal today
Can we hop on a quick call to align?
Best,
Maya (CSM)
```

jenna: That template is good. I'll prepare the onboarding checklist and share the runbook link: https://internal.redwood/onboarding/midmarket-accelerator (will post notes there once done) :white_check_mark:

leo: ETA for proxy is ~6 hours to stand up a test route + basic observability. I'll need infra approval for the short-lived tunnel. tagging @cs-bot to create an exec ticket.

cs-bot: Created ticket CS-#4827: "Rowan Health — temporary webhook proxy" assigned to infra-oncall. SLA target: 6h.

arun: I'll clear the commercial credit and loop in finance for the promo. Maya — can you confirm the exact discount wording? We should avoid language that looks like permanent pricing change.

maya: Will phrase as "one-time invoice credit equivalent to 30% of upcoming cycle" and include conditions (commit to 6mo, normal T&Cs).

jenna: Quick checklist for the session:
- Reconfirm goals + success metrics
- Walk through ingestion with proxy in place
- Validate 3 sample webhooks end-to-end
- Configure alerts and handoff to their eng owner

leo: I'll push a short demo script for proxy testing in the ticket.

maya: Timeline:
- Today: confirm plan and send comms (maya)
- +6h: infra approval / proxy standing (leo + infra)
- Fri 10am PT: onboarding session (jenna)
- Within 48–72h: proxy live for their systems
- Renewal decision: aim for within 7 days post-session

arun: Sounds good. If we get a solid signal post-onboard (tracking: event rate, config completion, NPS), we'll escalate to renewal exec for fast close.

maya: I'll send the email now. Will update thread with the customer response. Thanks team :pray:

cs-bot: Note added to account Rowan Health — playbook "midmarket stopgap" applied.

maya: Customer replied: "Appreciate the rapid response. Friday works — let's do the onboarding and see the proxy in action."

arun: Great. Keep the credit offer conditional. If they accept, we'll convert to committed renewal and remove downgrade path.

jenna: I'll prep the session doc and post in the runbook by EOD.

leo: Proxy route ready in staging. Linking to CS-#4827.

maya: Closing loop: session scheduled, proxy standing by, credit approved conditional. Moving to execution.

arun: Thanks all. Small, focused plays like this are our best churn prevention moves. :muscle:
